taste.name: Gray UI, Logos Carry the Color
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a page with nothing to prove except that big companies run on the product.
taste.decision: Chose a gray-only interface (#FAFAFA, #171717, #4D4D4D) over a brand-hue accent for CTAs and links.
taste.reason: The customer logos are the persuasion. If the interface has its own accent, OpenAI's and DoorDash's marks compete with it.
evidence: #297A3A appears x3, no other chroma in the UI

taste.name: Tight Regular-Weight Display Type
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a 64px headline that had to feel large without shouting.
taste.decision: Chose weight 400 with -0.06em tracking and 1.0 line-height over a bold display weight with default tracking.
taste.reason: At this size a bold weight looks heavy, and default tracking leaves gaps between letters. Tight regular type reads as one shape.
evidence: no weight above 500 in the sampled elements

taste.name: Rings, Not Shadows
taste.trigger: When the designers faced panels that had to separate from a near-white page.
taste.decision: Chose a 1px ring (rgba(0,0,0,0.08) or #EBEBEB) and a whiter fill (#FFFFFF on #FAFAFA) over blurred drop shadows or thick borders.
taste.reason: On a light page, drop shadows add gray haze under every panel. A 2% lightness step plus a hairline gives an edge without darkening the space around it.
evidence: no offset or blur shadow in the sampled set
radius 6px on utility buttons, pill on hero CTAs

taste.name: Edge-Anchored, Empty Between
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a wide screen and the usual choice of a centered container.
taste.decision: Chose a 12-column grid running gutter to gutter (24px margins, max-width none) with 208px between sections over a centered 1200px container.
taste.reason: Left-anchored headings, nav logo and logo row share one edge at x=24. With the space between sections left empty, each block reads on its own.
evidence: 12 columns x 92.72px, 24px gap, x=24 to x=1401
section gaps 208px measured twice, no dividers
h1, nav logo and logo row all start at x=24
